selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What is the main subject of the passage?
questions.answer: It explains how the making and shaping of living forms points to Allah’s oneness and power.

questions.question: In simple words, what is the “Truth of Opening”?
questions.answer: It is the truth that Allah brings many different living forms into being from simple beginnings.

questions.question: What does the phrase about “a single deed” teach?
questions.answer: It teaches that one divine act can produce many things at the same time.

questions.question: What do the Qur’anic verses add to the discussion besides examples?
questions.answer: They give revealed proof that Allah shapes human beings as He wills and rules all things.

questions.question: Why are the “three darknesses” meaningful in this discussion?
questions.answer: They show that Allah creates perfectly even in places hidden from human sight.

questions.question: Why is that important for the argument of the passage?
questions.answer: Because shaping all forms correctly requires complete awareness of everything.

questions.question: What kind of qualities are needed to unfold forms everywhere and all the time?
questions.answer: Wisdom, careful attention, broad control, and limitless power.

questions.question: Why can no limited being perform this deed, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Because the deed requires complete vision, full power, and control over all things.

questions.question: What details in the womb example show precision?
questions.answer: The forms are distinct, balanced, orderly, and free from mistakes.

questions.question: What role does comprehensiveness play in those earlier truths and in this one?
questions.answer: Their wide reach shows that the signs come from one Lord over all.

questions.question: What central belief is this passage trying to strengthen?
questions.answer: It is strengthening belief that Allah is One.

questions.question: In this passage, what does “opening” mean?
questions.answer: It means bringing out many different forms and identities from simple starting materials.

questions.question: What does the passage say about where this happens?
questions.answer: It happens everywhere.

questions.question: What is one reason the earth example is described as more amazing?
questions.answer: Because so many living species each receive a unique and carefully formed body.

questions.question: What fact about Allah’s knowledge supports His power to shape creation perfectly?
questions.answer: Nothing at all is hidden from Him.

questions.question: Why does the passage not go into full detail about this topic here?
questions.answer: Because it says this truth has already been explained in other places.

questions.question: What does the passage suggest about infinite power?
questions.answer: It says such power is necessary for this universal work and belongs only to Allah.

questions.question: What features of human formation in the womb are highlighted as signs?
questions.answer: Each person is formed separately, in balance, with order and a distinct shape, without mistakes or confusion.

questions.question: What belief error is rejected by the argument of this passage?
questions.answer: The idea that others could share in Allah’s creative authority is rejected.

questions.question: What is the first truth trying to help the traveler recognize?
questions.answer: That Allah’s oneness can be seen in the shaping of all living things.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the source from which many forms come forth?
questions.answer: It says many different forms come from one simple substance.

questions.question: What example from the earth is used to show this truth in a stronger way?
questions.answer: It mentions the many species of living creatures on earth, each with its own balanced and decorated form.

questions.question: How does the passage use the image of flowers?
questions.answer: It uses flowers as an example of many beautifully formed beings opened up by Allah’s power.

questions.question: What does the passage say is never hidden from Allah?
questions.answer: Nothing in the earth or the heavens.
